Anadolu via Getty Images A jury in London found comedian and actor Russell Brand guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. The actor had been charged on seven counts: three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of attempted indecent assault. Following Thursday s verdict, London s Metropolitan Police Service told Yahoo News that Brand, 51, was facing further allegations of rape from two women.
